units.source_text: 岛村朝她望去，突然缩了缩脖子。

en.t: Shimamura looked toward her and suddenly drew in his neck.

units.source_text: 镜子里白花花闪烁着的原来是雪。

en.t: What was gleaming white in the mirror was snow.

units.source_text: 在镜中的雪里现出了女子通红的脸颊。

en.t: In the snow within the mirror, the woman's crimson cheeks appeared.

units.source_text: 这是一种无法形容的纯洁的美。

en.t: It was a purity of beauty beyond description.
